## Why this evidence change is needed

The frozen H3 ordinary-process recovery gate passed, but the complete H3 attempt failed when an additional FinalUse process could not be bound to an actual parent using the old capture format. This checkpoint preserves that failure and its full original records, the actual post-run image archive, and a separately frozen H4 execution configuration on unchanged H3 source. It does not assign H3 a retrospective pass.

## Immutable checkpoint

- Evidence commit: [`571c3da959bcbcca6639a5882d49aebadd00bff2`](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/commit/571c3da959bcbcca6639a5882d49aebadd00bff2).
- [Complete review and remaining gates](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/571c3da959bcbcca6639a5882d49aebadd00bff2/evidence/joint-components-20261105/README.md).
- 2,013 files / 82,187,041 bytes. The complete local snapshot tree equals the actual remote subtree `3662bbd993ff706a0dd21d30405469208196dd8b`; other source and evidence entries are unchanged.

## Evidence retained

H3 job `1a1ada80dcc-fc05-5a8b` remains **FAILED / exit 1 / no outer timeout**. All 107 delivered small artifacts are retained and independently checked. Its 74 selected outcomes and original 6/10/50 additional outcomes passed, including the ordinary-process gate in 51.075 seconds. The process proof retains one provider POST, one physical application, two recovery lookups, the original operation ID, one nonce, and a durable succeeded readback. This is the controlled pre-fenced SIGKILL fixture; it does not close independent custody or sudden whole-host restoration.

The FinalUse command's 50 actual outcomes and 50 primary FD records are bijective. Its additional live PID remains unmatched because H3 did not record its contemporaneous parent chain. Full library, ignored listing, fix and final format were not run in H3.

H3's actual archive job succeeded within its fixed 900-second budget. Eleven complete images / 1,674,575,368 logical bytes are retained in a 283,427,280-byte archive with 68 parts. The authoritative terminal, completion, original stdout/stderr, five-range actual index, separate archive/member rehash and both exact owned-job releases are retained. Full H1/H2/H3 binary transport and local archive/part/member checks remain pending; a remotely successful archive is not yet a locally durable binary closure.

H4 uses the same `6db78eca53a5acdda0d96873d3f4cd65863426f0` source and C4 dependency binding. Its exact 12-member bundle, request and environment were independently frozen. All original steps, 74 selected names, FD verifier, full 161-name/one-ignored requirement, command budgets, 60-second cases and 5,400-second outer limit are preserved. The sole permitted FinalUse auxiliary child needs actual direct-parent PID/start, full argv, source and image agreement and receives no additional test credit. New utility controls are charged inside the original outer limit.

This checkpoint records H4's unique launch `1a1ade2970f-fc05-5b5c` and first **RUNNING** observation, including complete passing utility and 135/32 source logs. It deliberately contains no later H4 completion claim; subsequent original results will be appended as a separate checkpoint.

The complete C4 native/cost/raw archives, independent from-zero invalid-cost denominator, earlier H1/H2 failures, and the two real-learning workflow audits remain intact. No new trial, study reset, protected merge or activation was performed. No H3/H4 source PR was opened because the unchanged public-initial workflow can train from a new temporary store without loading the already-spent trial ledger. No original CI was disabled or skipped.

## Review status

All eight whole joint acceptance gates remain **HOLD**. In particular, original-resource public service execution, generic current-PQ effect-sink coverage, independent restoration, authentic complete-model cold adoption, frozen learning qualification, jointly affordable funded storage/state growth, and independent administrators with real WAN/fault domains remain required. The candidate's local bounded component results do not replace those obligations.

This PR remains draft and evidence-only. The canonical plan will receive a separate strictly stacked one-document append against its current plan branch after the final actual evidence is available.
